title: 第452章  楚枫的骑君之罪！
content_zh:
纪沉渔抬起右手，纤细的食指指向蜷缩在赵翠身后的纪云。
“杀。”
赵翠猛地瞪大了眼睛，脸上所有的血色都在这一瞬间褪尽。
她张开双臂挡在纪云身前，如同被踩住尾巴的猫。
“纪沉渔！你疯了吗！他可是你亲弟弟啊！”
纪沉渔转过头，凤眸中没有半分波澜，只有一片深不见底的冰冷。
“我的娘亲叫柳芙蓉，我只有一个亲妹妹，叫纪沉月。”
纪云浑身颤抖，双腿软得几乎站不住。
他看出来了，纪沉渔是真的要杀他。
“娘！娘！救我！”
韩子墨手中长枪枪出如龙，一道金色枪罡从枪尖迸发，如同一颗金色流星般贯穿了纪云的胸口。
枪尖从胸前刺入，鲜血顺着枪杆缓缓滴落。
纪云的声音戛然而止，他低头看着自己胸口那个碗口大的血洞，张了张嘴想说些什么，却只能从喉咙里发出一声含混不清的咯咯声。
他都身体抽搐了几下，彻底失去了生机。
韩子墨手腕一抖，长枪从纪云胸口抽出，带出一蓬暗红的血雾。
纪云的尸体软软地瘫倒在地，那双瞪大的眼睛依旧盯着纪沉渔的方向，瞳孔中的光芒却已彻底消散。
赵翠呆呆地看着地上那具逐渐冰冷的尸体，整个人如同被抽去了魂魄。
她这辈子唯一的指望，就这样被人一枪捅死在眼前。
“纪沉渔！你这个蛇蝎心肠的贱人！你杀了我儿子！”
“赵家，灭族！”

纪沉渔的声音没有半分波澜，却让在场所有人都感到一股彻骨的寒意。
闻听此言，赵翠的咒骂戛然而止，整个人僵在原地。
赵祥更是遍体生寒，若是以往纪沉渔说出这话，他只当纪沉渔是疯了。
可是如今这两个字从纪沉渔口中说出，他毫不怀疑她会做到。
他下意识后退了一步，声音都在剧烈颤抖。
“你凭什么灭我赵家！”
韩子墨没有丝毫废话，手中长枪骤然迸发出金色光芒。
大乘期的威压毫无保留地释放，枪罡如同一条咆哮的金色巨龙般朝赵祥轰去。
枪罡所过之处，虚空被撕出尖锐的破空之声，院中青石地面寸寸崩裂。
赵祥瞳孔皱缩，连忙从纳戒中祭出一面通体暗青的骨盾。
玄冥骨盾是他压箱底的六品防御法宝，以化神期妖兽的脊骨炼制而成，可挡合体期全力一击。
他将全身灵力毫无保留地灌入骨盾之中，盾面在他身前凝聚成一道厚重的骨墙。
然而韩子墨可是大乘期的修为，金色枪罡撞上骨墙的瞬间，玄冥骨盾如同纸糊般被轰得粉碎。
金色的枪罡穿透骨墙后去势未消，狠狠轰在赵祥胸口。
赵祥的身体在半空中轰然炸开，化作一团暗红的血雾。
碎骨与血肉如同暴雨般洒落，溅在赵翠的脸上。
大乘期的一击，炼虚期连惨叫都来不及发出，便已形神俱灭。
韩子墨收回长枪，目光落在瘫软在地的赵翠身上，眼中闪过一丝微不可察的犹豫。
这个女人毕竟是纪沉渔名义上的母亲，虽然她罪该万死，但他身为臣子，当众斩杀陛下的继母，终究有些不妥。
就在他犹豫的那一瞬间，身后传来楚枫的声音。

“韩子墨，你想抗旨？”
韩子墨浑身猛然一震，抗旨，这两个字如同一盆冰水从头浇到脚，将他心中那丝犹豫浇得干干净净。
他不再有任何迟疑，长枪在手中挽了个枪花，枪尖裹挟着刺耳的破空之声，朝赵翠刺去。
赵翠看着那柄越来越近的金色长枪，眼中所有的怨毒都在这一瞬间被恐惧所取代。
“纪沉渔，你残害家人同族，你不得好死——”
话还没说完，韩子墨的枪尖已刺入她的口中，枪刃从后脑贯穿而出。
她的声音戛然而止，鲜血顺着枪杆汩汩流淌，那双瞪大的眼睛里满是惊恐。
她的身体抽搐了几下，然后如同一滩烂泥般瘫软在地。
纪天霸站在院中，浑身剧烈颤抖，双腿几乎支撑不住自己的身体。
直到此刻，他才发现自己从来不曾真正了解过这个女儿。
她竟然这么狠，说杀就杀，连眼睛都不眨一下。
也是直到此刻他才真正明白，百官真正看重的从来不是仙灵根，而是他女儿和楚枫之间的这层关系。
有了楚枫，莫说仙灵根，便是凡品灵根也足以坐稳龙椅。
没有楚枫，便是觉醒了仙品灵根，也成不了一国之君。
他竟然还傻傻地认为，只要把仙灵根移植到纪云体内，自己的儿子就能做皇帝。
他强压下心中的恐惧，挤出一丝比哭还难看的笑容，小心翼翼地凑到纪沉渔面前。
“沉渔，爹是被赵翠那个悍妇蒙蔽了，你要相信爹——”
纪沉渔转过头，冷声道。
“请父亲称陛下！”
纪天霸浑身猛然一震，嘴唇剧烈颤抖，良久才艰难地改口。

“陛、陛下。”
纪沉渔走到纪天霸面前，她的身量比纪天霸矮了半个头，可此刻她的气势却如同一座不可逾越的高山，压得纪天霸根本不敢抬头直视。
“在你袖手旁观别人挖我灵根的时候，你的女儿就已经死了。”
纪天霸双腿终于再也支撑不住，噗通一声跪倒在地。
他后悔了，真的后悔了……
可这世上哪有什么后悔药？
纪天霸猛地转头，看到了负手立于不远处的楚枫。
他连滚带爬地扑到楚枫面前，双手紧紧抓住楚枫的衣摆。
“女婿，好女婿，你再给我一次机会，你替我跟沉渔说说情，让她饶了我这一次！
我知道错了，我真的知道错了，我以后一定好好待她们姐妹，我什么都听她的——”
楚枫抬起手，一巴掌扇在纪天霸脸上。
“给你机会你不中用啊！”
皇宫，紫宸殿。
幽幽月光透过油窗纸洒入殿中，透过油窗纸可以清楚地看到外边巡视的禁军路过。
殿内烛火已燃至尽头，只剩几缕极淡的暖光还在微微摇曳，在殿墙上投出两道交叠的身影。
纪沉渔身着赤金龙袍，修长的玉腿搭在龙椅扶手上，龙袍从腿侧滑落，露出一截莹白如雪的小腿。
她的后背紧贴着龙椅靠背，身前却是楚枫滚烫的胸膛。
她似乎是明白了楚枫想在这里干什么，紧抿着薄唇，那双凤眸中翻涌起压抑不住的紧张。
白日里，女帝的杀伐果断早已经荡然无存，只是不住地摇头哀求。
“不要在这……”

楚枫俯身，将她整个人笼罩在龙椅与他之间那片极狭小的空间里。
他低垂着眼帘看着她那张早已红透的脸，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹意味深长的弧度。
“陛下也不想让人知道今夜的事情吧。”
纪沉渔浑身剧烈一颤，整个人都起了一层细密的鸡皮疙瘩。
龙靴坠地，盈盈月光照进纤白罗袜，玲珑玉足的足趾骤然蜷缩。
一个时辰后。
沐浴完的楚枫换上一身干净的素白寝衣，推开寝殿的门。
殿内烛火已尽数熄灭，只有窗外透入的月光在地面上铺开一层清冷的银辉。
他走到床前，正欲掀开被褥，却发现被褥里蜷缩着一个娇小的身影，不是纪沉渔。
纪沉月只露出一个脑袋，双手紧紧攥着被褥边缘，杏眸中满是不安。
她的目光躲闪着不敢看他，纤长的睫毛在月光下微微颤动。
“姐姐让我给你暖床……”
楚枫看着被褥中那张与纪沉渔有几分相似的脸，顿时明白了纪沉渔的意思。
他深吸一口气，抬手掀开了被褥。
云鬓花颜金步摇，芙蓉帐暖度春宵。
直到日上三竿，楚枫才被纪沉渔叫醒。
她已换上一身崭新的赤金龙袍，坐在床沿，手指轻轻推着楚枫的肩膀。
“夫君，早朝都散了，该用早膳了。”
纪沉月整个人缩在被窝里，只露出一小撮乌黑的发顶，连呼吸都刻意压得极轻，根本不敢出来见人。
洗漱过后，楚枫坐在餐桌旁，从纳戒中取出一张符箓，放在纪沉渔面前。

符纸薄如蝉翼，刻着上古封魂符文，散发出令人窒息的仙王境威压。
符箓出现的瞬间，整座紫宸殿的温度都骤降了几分，桌案上那杯刚沏好的热茶表面竟凝结出一层冰霜。
“这是什么符箓，好强的力量！”
纪沉渔怔怔地看着那张符纸，她修行至今见过最强的符箓不过是天岚圣朝国库中珍藏的八品符箓。
可那张符散发出的威压与眼前这张相比，如同萤火之于皓月。
“这是神降符，我当初斩杀冰渊噬魂蜮所得。
只要催动此符，便能借助符箓中封印的仙王境力量为己所用。”
楚枫将符箓塞进她手中，继续说道。
“之前我离开得太匆忙，没有给你留下保命之物，让赵祥有机可乘，险些毁了你的灵根。
这张神降符留给你，算是保命的手段，仙王境的力量足以碾压九帝祖界任何存在。”
纪沉渔低头看着神降符，心中却涌起一股说不清道不明的酸涩。
她知道，楚枫不会无缘无故给她护身法宝。
给她防身之物，便证明他要走了。
“这符箓太过贵重了，你留着防身，毕竟你要去的是仙界，那里的危险远比这里更多。
我有韩子墨护卫，还有你留下的天仙傀儡，不会有事。”
“靠谁都不如靠自己，这世上任何人都有可能背叛，唯独这张符不会。”
楚枫又将符箓推回她手中，而后继续说道。
“况且，如今这张符箓对我来说已经用不上了，你留着它比我有用。”
闻言，纪沉渔没有再推辞。
楚枫又抬手在虚空中一抹，数十个玉盒从纳戒中飞出，整齐地排列在桌案上。

玉盒依次
纪沉渔红唇微张，眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
“这、这些都是仙品以上的天材地宝！”
回过神来之后，她连连摆手。
“夫君，这些太贵重了，而且国库之中存了够多的修炼资源了，我在九帝祖界修炼绰绰有余。”
“嘘！”
楚枫直接抬手，食指轻轻压在她的唇上，将她后面的话尽数堵了回去。
“这些修炼资源对于如今的我来说已经用不上了，留在纳戒里也是占地方。”
这十天他走遍了九帝祖界，该杀的人杀了，该见的人都见了，修炼资源能留下的也都留下了。
纪沉渔闻言，眸中的光芒微微颤动了一下。
她沉默了好一会儿，才轻声问道。
“你要走了吗？”
楚枫点了点头：“我还有许多事要去做。”
纪沉渔站起身来，走到楚枫身旁。
她微微俯身，红唇凑近他耳畔。
“走之前，可以给我留一个孩子吗？”
楚枫端着粥碗的手微微一顿，在吃早饭和吃渔之间，最终还是选择了先吃渔。
很快，大殿中便传出了女帝急促的呼吸声。
content_en:
Ji Chenyu raised his right hand and pointed his slender index finger at Ji Yun, who was curled up behind Zhao Cui.
"Kill."
Zhao Cui's eyes suddenly widened, and all the blood on his face faded at this moment.
She opened her arms to block Ji Yun, like a cat whose tail was stepped on.
"Ji Chenyu! Are you crazy! He is your biological brother!"
Ji Chenyu turned his head, there was no wave in his eyes, only a bottomless coldness.
"My mother's name is Liu Furong, and I only have one biological sister, her name is Ji Chenyue."
Ji Yun was trembling all over and his legs were so weak that he could hardly stand.
He could see that Ji Chenyu really wanted to kill him.
"Mother! Mother! Save me!"
The spear in Han Zimo's hand shot out like a dragon, and a golden spear burst out from the tip of the spear, piercing Ji Yun's chest like a golden meteor.
The tip of the gun pierced through the chest, and blood slowly dripped down the gun barrel.
Ji Yun's voice stopped suddenly. He looked down at the blood hole as big as a bowl on his chest. He opened his mouth to say something, but he could only make an indistinct gurgling sound from his throat.
He twitched several times and completely lost his life.
Han Zimo flicked his wrist and pulled out the spear from Ji Yun's chest, bringing out a dark red mist of blood.
Ji Yun's body collapsed softly to the ground, his wide eyes still staring in the direction of Ji Chenyu, but the light in his pupils had completely dissipated.
Zhao Cui stared blankly at the gradually cold body on the ground, as if his soul had been sucked out of him.
Her only hope in this life was shot to death in front of her eyes.
"Ji Chenyu! You snake-hearted bitch! You killed my son!"
"Zhao family, annihilate the clan!"
Ji Chenyu's voice was without any ripples, but it made everyone present feel a chill to the core.
After hearing this, Zhao Cui's cursing stopped abruptly and he froze in place.
Zhao Xiang felt chills all over his body. If he had said this to Ji Chenyu, he would have thought that Ji Chenyu was crazy.
But now that these two words came out of Ji Chenyu's mouth, he had no doubt that she would do it.
He subconsciously took a step back, his voice trembling violently.
"Why do you destroy my Zhao family!"
Han Zimo said nothing nonsense, and the spear in his hand suddenly burst out with golden light.
The pressure of the Mahayana stage was released without reservation, and the spear blasted towards Zhao Xiang like a roaring golden dragon.
Wherever the spear passed, the void was torn apart with a sharp sound, and the bluestone ground in the courtyard cracked inch by inch.
Zhao Xiang's pupils shrank, and he quickly took out a dark green bone shield from the ring.
The Xuanming Bone Shield is his sixth-level defensive magic weapon at the bottom of the box. It is made from the spine of a monster in the God Transformation Stage. It can block a full blow from the Physical Stage.
He poured all his spiritual energy into the bone shield without reservation, and the shield condensed into a thick bone wall in front of him.
However, Han Zimo was at the Mahayana stage. The moment the golden spear hit the bone wall, the Xuanming Bone Shield was shattered like paper.
The golden gun-gang penetrated the bone wall and remained strong, hitting Zhao Xiang's chest hard.
Zhao Xiang's body exploded in mid-air and turned into a dark red blood mist.
Broken bones and flesh and blood fell like a rainstorm, splashing on Zhao Cui's face.
A blow from the Mahayana stage, the Void Refining stage didn't even have time to scream, and both body and soul were destroyed.
Han Zimo withdrew his spear, and his eyes fell on Zhao Cui who was lying limply on the ground, with a trace of undetectable hesitation flashing in his eyes.
After all, this woman was Ji Chenyu's nominal mother. Although she deserved death, as a minister, it was inappropriate for him to kill His Majesty's stepmother in public.
At the moment he hesitated, Chu Feng's voice came from behind him.
"Han Zimo, do you want to resist the decree?"
Han Zimo's whole body trembled suddenly, "Resist". These two words were like a basin of ice water poured from head to toe, pouring away any trace of hesitation in his heart.
He no longer hesitated, and held the spear in his hand. The tip of the spear stabbed towards Zhao Cui with a harsh sound of breaking through the air.Zhao Cui looked at the golden spear that was getting closer and closer, and all the resentment in his eyes was replaced by fear at this moment.
"Ji Chenyu, you killed your family and fellow tribesmen, you will not die a good death——"
Before she could finish her words, the tip of Han Zimo's spear had penetrated into her mouth, and the blade of the spear penetrated from the back of her head.
Her voice stopped suddenly, blood flowed down the gun barrel, and her wide eyes were full of fear.
Her body twitched a few times, then collapsed to the ground like a puddle of mud.
Ji Tianba stood in the courtyard, his whole body shaking violently, his legs could barely support his body.
Until this moment, he realized that he had never really understood this daughter.
She was so ruthless, killing at will without blinking an eye.
It was not until this moment that he truly understood that what Baiguan really valued was never the fairy root, but the relationship between his daughter and Chu Feng.
With Chu Feng, not to mention fairy spiritual roots, even ordinary spiritual roots are enough to sit firmly on the dragon throne.
Without Chu Feng, even if he awakened his immortal spiritual roots, he would not be able to become the king of a country.
He even foolishly believed that as long as the fairy root was transplanted into Ji Yun's body, his son could become the emperor.
He suppressed the fear in his heart, forced out a smile that was uglier than crying, and cautiously approached Ji Chenyu.
"Shen Yu, dad was deceived by that shrew Zhao Cui. You have to believe dad-"
Ji Chenyu turned his head and said coldly.
"Father, please call me Your Majesty!"
Ji Tianba's whole body was shaken suddenly, his lips trembled violently, and it took him a long time to change his words with difficulty.
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty."
Ji Chenyu walked up to Ji Tianba. She was half a head shorter than Ji Tianba, but at this moment, her aura was like an insurmountable mountain, so heavy that Ji Tianba didn't dare to look up.
"While you stood by and watched others dig out my spiritual roots, your daughter was already dead."
Ji Tianba's legs finally couldn't support him anymore and he fell to his knees with a thud.
He regretted it, really regretted it...
But is there any regret medicine in this world?
Ji Tianba suddenly turned his head and saw Chu Feng standing not far away with his hands behind his back.
He rolled and crawled in front of Chu Feng, grabbing the hem of Chu Feng's clothes tightly with both hands.
"Son-in-law, good son-in-law, give me another chance, intercede with Shen Yu for me, and ask her to spare me this time!
I know it’s wrong, I really know it’s wrong, I will definitely treat their sisters well in the future, and I will listen to her in everything—”
Chu Feng raised his hand and slapped Ji Tianba on the face.
"I gave you a chance but you didn't use it!"
Imperial Palace, Zichen Hall.
The faint moonlight shines through the oil window paper into the hall. Through the oil window paper, you can clearly see the patrolling imperial guards passing by outside.
The candlelight in the hall has burned to the end, and only a few wisps of very faint warm light are still swaying slightly, casting two overlapping figures on the wall of the hall.
Ji Chenyu was wearing a red gold dragon robe, with his slender jade legs resting on the armrests of the dragon chair. The dragon robe slipped off the sides of his legs, revealing a calf as white as snow.
Her back was pressed against the backrest of the dragon chair, but in front of her was Chu Feng's hot chest.
She seemed to understand what Chu Feng wanted to do here, she pursed her thin lips tightly, and uncontrollable tension surged in her phoenix eyes.
During the day, the empress's decisiveness to kill had long since disappeared, and she just kept shaking her head and pleading.
"Don't be here..."
Chu Feng leaned forward and enveloped her whole body in the extremely narrow space between the dragon chair and him.
He lowered his eyes and looked at her already red face, and the corners of his mouth slowly raised a meaningful arc.
"Your Majesty doesn't want people to know what happened tonight."
Ji Chenyu trembled violently, and a layer of goosebumps appeared all over his body.
The dragon boots fell to the ground, the moonlight shone into the slender white socks, and the toes of the exquisite jade feet suddenly curled up.
An hour later.
After bathing, Chu Feng put on clean white pajamas and opened the door to the dormitory.
All the candles in the hall have been extinguished, and only the moonlight shines through the window.Spread a layer of cool silver glow on the ground.
He walked to the bed and was about to lift the quilt, but found a petite figure curled up in the quilt, and it was not Ji Chenyu.
Only Ji Chenyue's head was exposed, her hands tightly grasping the edge of the quilt, her almond-shaped eyes full of uneasiness.
Her eyes avoided looking at him, and her long eyelashes trembled slightly in the moonlight.
"Sister asked me to warm your bed..."
Chu Feng looked at the face in the quilt that was somewhat similar to Ji Chenyu's, and immediately understood what Ji Chenyu meant.
He took a deep breath and raised his hand to lift the quilt.
The flowers on the temples are swaying with golden steps, and the hibiscus tent warms the spring night.
It wasn't until three o'clock in the morning that Chu Feng was woken up by Ji Chenyu.
She had put on a brand new red gold dragon robe, sat on the edge of the bed, and gently pushed Chu Feng's shoulders with her fingers.
"Husband, the morning court is over, it's time for breakfast."
Ji Chenyue huddled under the quilt, with only a handful of black hair exposed. She even breathed very softly, not daring to come out to see anyone.
After washing, Chu Feng sat at the dining table, took out a talisman from the ring, and placed it in front of Ji Chenyu.
The talisman paper is as thin as cicada wings, engraved with ancient soul-sealing runes, exuding the suffocating pressure of the Immortal King Realm.
The moment the talisman appeared, the temperature of the entire Zichen Palace dropped sharply, and a layer of frost actually condensed on the surface of the cup of freshly brewed hot tea on the table.
"What kind of talisman is this? It's so powerful!"
Ji Chenyu stared at the talisman paper blankly. The strongest talisman she had seen so far in her practice was only the eighth-grade talisman treasured in the treasury of the Tianlan Holy Dynasty.
But compared to the one in front of me, the coercion exuded by that talisman was like a firefly to a bright moon.
"This is the Divine Talisman, which I got from killing the Ice Abyss Soul-Eating Monster.
As long as this talisman is activated, the Immortal King Realm power sealed in the talisman can be used for one's own purposes. "
Chu Feng put the talisman into her hand and continued.
“I left in too hasty before and didn’t leave you anything to save your life, which gave Zhao Xiang an opportunity and almost destroyed your spiritual roots.
This divine talisman is left to you as a way to save your life. The power of the Immortal King Realm is enough to crush any existence in the Nine Emperors Ancestral Realm. "
Ji Chenyu lowered his head and looked at the Divine Talisman, but there was an indescribable sourness in his heart.
She knew that Chu Feng would not give her a protective magic weapon for no reason.
Giving her something to defend herself would prove that he was leaving.
"This talisman is too valuable. Keep it for self-defense. After all, you are going to the fairy world, where there are far more dangers than here.
I have Han Zimo to protect me and the immortal puppet you left behind, so nothing will happen to me. "
"It is better to rely on yourself than to rely on anyone. Anyone in this world may betray, but this talisman will not."
Chu Feng pushed the talisman back into her hand, and then continued.
"Besides, this talisman is no longer of use to me. It will be more useful to you if you keep it."
Hearing this, Ji Chenyu did not refuse.
Chu Feng raised his hand and touched the void again, and dozens of jade boxes flew out from the ring and were neatly arranged on the table.

Ji Chenyu's red lips parted slightly, and his eyes nearly popped out.
"These, these are all heavenly materials and earthly treasures above the immortal level!"
After coming to her senses, she waved her hands repeatedly.
"Husband, these are too valuable, and there are enough cultivation resources stored in the national treasury. It is more than enough for me to cultivate in the Nine Emperors Ancestral Realm."
"Shh!"
Chu Feng directly raised his hand and gently pressed his index finger on her lips, blocking out all her next words.
"These cultivation resources are no longer useful to me now, and staying in Najie will only take up space."
In the past ten days, he traveled throughout the Nine Emperors Ancestral Realm, killing those who should be killed, meeting everyone who should be seen, and keeping all the cultivation resources he could.
When Ji Chenyu heard this, the light in his eyes trembled slightly.
She was silent for a while and then asked softly.
"Are you leaving?"
Chu Feng nodded: "I still have many things to do."
Ji Chenyu stood up and walked to Chu Fengbeside.
She leaned forward slightly and brought her red lips close to his ear.
"Before you leave, can you leave me a child?"
Chu Feng paused slightly while holding the porridge bowl. Between having breakfast and eating fish, he finally chose to eat fish first.
Soon, the rapid breathing of the empress could be heard in the hall.
